name: reactzyme_native_bag_adapter_v1
goal: Map unordered ReactZyme-style molecule bags into the existing frozen RDKit+ reaction latent without deleting training data or modifying the production dual tower.

input.semantics: substrate and product molecule lists are concatenated; side identity and direction are intentionally discarded
input.fingerprint: RDKit Morgan bit fingerprint radius=2 fpSize=2048 useChirality=false
input.invalid_molecule_policy: skip invalid molecule; all-invalid bag becomes zero vector

evaluation.baseline: same frozen fold teacher reaction embedding against the same frozen protein tower and full candidate library
evaluation.selection_scope: folds 0/1/2 are development evidence only; no external ReactZyme metric may select this adapter

screening_gate.decision: If and only if all gates pass, freeze a fresh salted strict-double-cold confirmation protocol before any confirmation score. If a gate fails, V1 is rejected; no claim is made from ReactZyme external labels.

forbidden: training on ReactZyme external test labels
modifying the frozen protein or reaction tower
changing V1 hyperparameters after seeing V1 fold metrics and rerunning under the same V1 name
